<plan>1. Wait until energy is fully replenished while sleeping (energy 9/9).  
2. Stand still and With the stone block still in the world in front of you, perform <action>Place Stone</action> to leave your first stone block in the world and unlock the "Place Stone" achievement.  
3. Immediately issue <action>Place Table</action> to spawn a table, earning the "Place Table" achievement.  
4. Use the newly built table to craft a wood sword: <action>Make Wood Sword</action>, giving the "Make Wood Sword" skill.  
5. Place the sapling from your inventory with <action>Place Plant</action> (achieves "Place Plant").  
6. In front of the newly placed sapling, issue <action>Do</action> to eat it, scoring the "Eat Plant" achievement.  
7. Mine the stone block you just placed to reclaim a stone item: move next to it and <action>Do</action>, adding another stone to inventory.  
8. With stone available, place a furnace adjacent to the table: <action>Place Furnace</action> for the "Place Furnace" achievement.  
9. Mine fuel and resources (coal, etc.) from nearby to craft better tools: use wood pickaxe to mine coal, then use the furnace to smelt it into iron if desired, allowing later achievements such as "Make Iron Pickaxe" and "Make Iron Sword".  
10. With a sword ready, move to the nearest hostile mobs: use sword to defeat the skeleton (earning "Defeat Skeleton") and later the zombie (earning "Defeat Zombie").  
11. Continue collecting resources, eating food when low on health, and exploring the world to unlock the remaining achievements (Collect Wood, Collect Sample, Collect Drink, Collect Iron, Collect Diamond, etc.).  
12. When health or hunger drops, seek food or heal naturally; maintain energy by resting when needed.  
13. Iterate through these steps, ensuring each achievement is earned, while watching your health, hunger, and energy to stay alive.<plan>
